answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Entry needs a vouching bond — an established identity stakes 72 POA behind each newcomer and loses it on conviction. A sybil operator must buy sponsors for every fake, turning each alias into a 72-POA liability instead of a free account. Nobody vouches for a stranger when the slash climbs to their own stake. What carries the onyx here is verification, the terrace of cost is what stops the farm, and the juniper of the record keeps every claim checkable. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
